app.name: Mnemonic
app.tagline: Study with answers you can verify

access.title: Enter your access code
access.description: Mnemonic is in a closed preview. Paste the access code you were given.
access.label: Access code
access.wrong: This code was not accepted. Check it and try again.
access.unreachable: Can't reach the server, so the code could not be checked. Check your connection and press Continue to retry.

chat.title: What do you want to learn?
chat.subtitle: Ask about the knowledge base or your own documents. Every answer cites its sources, or says it doesn't know.
suggestions: How do I declare a path parameter in FastAPI?
What is dependency injection in FastAPI?
How do I validate a request body with Pydantic?

documents.subtitle: Upload your own notes. Answers in chat can then cite them.
documents.hint: {{types}} · up to {{mb}} MB · at most {{max}} documents
documents.confirmText: “{{name}}” will be removed and chat answers will no longer cite it.
documents.errType: This file type isn't supported. Use {{types}}.
documents.errSize: The file is larger than {{mb}} MB.
documents.errLimit: You can keep at most {{max}} documents. Delete one first.
documents.emptyText: Upload your notes (.md, .txt, .pdf) and ask questions about them in chat.

flashcards.emptyText: Ask a question in chat. When the answer finishes, press “Make flashcards” under it. Your decks will appear here.
flashcards.subtitle: Decks you made from answers. They are stored in this browser.
flashcards.confirmText: The cards are stored only in this browser and cannot be restored.
flashcards.question: Question
flashcards.flipHint: Click or press Space to reveal

settings.title: Settings
settings.accessText: Your access code is stored in this browser. Signing out removes it.

errors.network: Can't reach the server. Check your connection and try again.
